confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are the most reliable; hostel anchors are least certain because Palm Springs has few registered hostels. July is low season with extreme heat, so accommodation anchors reflect summer off-season rates including taxes and typical resort or mandatory fees. Restaurant figures are menu prices before tip. The FX observation comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA homepage that I could not verify on the RBA page itself; third-party aggregators showed about 0.6923 to 0.6947 USD per AUD for 16 October 2026, consistent with it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of inland Southern California desert resort towns (such as Palm Desert and Indio) in summer off-season, with US restaurant and lodging price levels.
